title: TokenFlow branch receipt (v1)
description: A portable, self-contained record of what one branch cost, designed to travel with the code as a git note (refs/notes/tokenflow) rather than live on a server. Every cost figure is estimated locally from token counts against a local price table, never measured billing, unless the underlying records say otherwise; see docs/receipt-schema.md. Version 1 adds an optional ticket link and an optional budget verdict on top of every field version 0 required. A v0 receipt is not a valid v1 receipt (schemaVersion differs), but every field v0 required is still required here.

schemaVersion.description: Receipt schema version. This document describes version 1.

generatedAt.description: When this receipt was computed, in UTC ISO-8601.

toolVersion.description: The TokenFlow package version that computed this receipt (package.json version).

repo.description: The repository's name — the basename of its main checkout, resolved through git worktrees. Never a full path.

branch.description: The branch this receipt attributes spend to.

headSha.description: The commit sha this receipt is attached to (the local sha being pushed).

window.description: The first and last timestamp of a priced turn attributed to this branch, or null when there were none.

costUsd.description: Estimated spend attributed to this branch, in US dollars. null when no turn on this branch had a priced model — never 0.

contextShare.description: Share of costUsd that paid to re-send prior context (cache reads + writes) rather than fresh input/output. A high share is the price of a long session, not necessarily waste.

turns.description: Number of primary-measurement turns attributed to this branch.

sessions.description: Number of distinct sessions that touched this branch.

subagentTurns.description: Of turns, how many ran as a subagent.

models.description: Spend broken down by model family, most expensive first.

coverage.description: Share of this branch's turns that used a model with a configured price. Turns outside this coverage are counted but excluded from costUsd.

largestPromptTokens.description: The largest single prompt (input + cache read + cache write tokens) seen on this branch.

changedLines.description: Additions + deletions of the matched pull request, when one was supplied. null with no matched PR.

pr.description: The pull request this receipt's headline window is scoped to (turns up to its merge), or null when none was supplied/matched.

longLived.description: True for a long-lived branch name (main, staging, …): this receipt is for a period of work on it, not one change.

costPer100Lines.description: costUsd divided by changedLines, scaled to 100 lines. null with no matched PR, no changed lines, or no priced turns.

notes.description: Honesty caveats in plain sentences: e.g. unpriced turns excluded from costUsd, a long-lived branch covering a period, work that predates the matched PR, that costs are estimated locally and no prompt or code content was read.

ticket.description: The tracked-work item (Jira/Linear/GitHub issue/other) this branch's work is filed against, or null when none is known. Populated by the cost-per-ticket stream; this is the contract shape it writes to.

verdict.description: The result of checking this receipt against a declared budget, or null when no budget was declared for this comparison.
